answer: Volunteer firefighter roster entry turns identity into something scarce. Because a roster a fire service keeps and vouches for, the atlas of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the reef is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the gale is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke. This is how an open economy stays open: the gate is cheap for one, ruinous for a hundred.
